Carving away small sections and smoothing each surface, she gradually turns a simple mound into shapes with surprisingly crisp edges and intricate details. The process is mesmerizing to watch, especially knowing how temporary the finished work is. Each sculpture takes patience and precision, even though the sand will eventually lose its shape. Danish artist Simon Lindbeej explores interaction and emergence through a kinetic cabinet that brings together magnetism, mirrors and shadow patterns. Developed since 2025, the work turns furniture into a dynamic system where components influence each other, generating shifting visual rhythms and unexpected formations. Known for blending craftsmanship with experimental mechanics, Lindbeej’s practice has been presented in design and art contexts across Copenhagen, pushing the boundaries between sculpture, design and movement. #kineticart #kineticsculpture #artanddesign #experimentalart #woodworking
